form.label: Overview
form.description: What needs attention right now. Refreshes every 5 minutes.

search.query: | `expected_hosts` | join type=left host [| tstats max(_time) as last where index=* by host | eval host=lower(host)] | eval minutes_quiet=if(isnull(last), "never seen", round((now()-last)/60)) | where isnull(last) OR last < relative_time(now(), "-10m") | table host minutes_quiet | stats count

html.p: Work each one with the playbook quick reference. Full list: Activity, Triggered Alerts.

search.query: `splunk_audit` action=alert_fired | stats count latest(_time) as last by ss_name severity | sort -severity -last | convert ctime(last) | rename ss_name as alert

html.p: Severity 5. A host on the expected_hosts list sent nothing for 10 minutes. Playbook steps (page 18)

search.query: | `expected_hosts` | join type=left host [| tstats max(_time) as last where index=* by host | eval host=lower(host)] | eval minutes_quiet=if(isnull(last), "never seen", round((now()-last)/60)) | where isnull(last) OR last < relative_time(now(), "-10m") | table host minutes_quiet

html.p: DNS, WinRM, SQL, RDP and file sharing are scored. A stop here can turn the scoreboard red.

search.query: `windows_system` EventCode=7036 "stopped state" ("SQL Server" OR "Windows Remote Management" OR "DNS Server" OR "Remote Desktop Services" OR "The Server service" OR "World Wide Web" OR "Active Directory" OR "Kerberos" OR "Netlogon") | table _time host Message

panel.title: Scored services: Linux services stopped or failed

search.query: `linux_syslog` ("Stopped" OR "Failed with result" OR "Main process exited") (httpd OR nginx OR apache2 OR postfix OR dovecot OR vsftpd OR sshd OR ssh OR mariadb OR mysqld OR mysql OR php-fpm OR Splunkd OR SplunkForwarder) | table _time host _raw
`web_access` status>=500 | timechart span=5m count by host

html.p: Severity 5. An account hit the lockout limit. A locked scoring account takes its service down. Playbook steps (page 8)

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4740 | eval locked_account=mvindex(Account_Name,-1) | table _time host locked_account Caller_Computer_Name
(`windows_security` EventCode=4625) OR (`linux_auth` "Failed password") | timechart span=5m count by host
